kicker.zh: 型号 / 接口 / 材料

intro.en: Find a cable model or material part number, then send it for a custom replacement or original-part sourcing review.
intro.zh: 按成品型号或材料料号查找，提交编号即可沟通兼容替代件制作或原厂件采购。

search_label.en: Find a model or part number

search_placeholder.en: Brand, model, part number or product type
search_placeholder.zh: 输入品牌、型号、料号或产品类型

empty.en: No matching references. Try a brand, full part number or a listed alias.
empty.zh: 未找到匹配项，请尝试品牌、完整料号或已列出的别名。

intro.en: Industrial Ethernet and RJ45 patch cable assemblies.
intro.zh: 工业以太网与 RJ45 预制电缆组件。

intro.en: Ethernet bulk cable and industrial network connector components.
intro.zh: 以太网原线与工业网络连接材料。

checks_title.en: Six Decisions Behind the Part Number
checks_title.zh: 型号背后的六个选型要点

copy.en: Define RJ45 or circular interfaces, connector coding and the target industrial network.
copy.zh: 明确 RJ45 或圆形接口、接头编码及目标工业网络。

copy.en: Confirm pair assignment and straight-through or crossover wiring against the equipment.
copy.zh: 按设备要求确认线对分配、直通或交叉接线。

copy.en: Choose cable category, conductor construction and length for the specified link.
copy.zh: 针对目标链路选择线缆类别、导体结构与长度。

copy.en: Keep shield construction and connector grounding aligned with the installation design.
copy.zh: 使屏蔽结构、接头接地与现场安装设计保持一致。

copy.en: Distinguish fixed, cabinet and moving installations. Check bend radius and connector clearance.
copy.zh: 区分固定、柜内和运动布线，并核对弯曲半径与接头空间。

copy.en: Agree wire-map checks and any required cable or link performance testing.
copy.zh: 约定线序检查及所需的线缆或链路性能测试。

boundary.en: Send the part number, drawing or sample to confirm the replacement configuration and sourcing plan.
boundary.zh: 请提供型号、图纸或样品，具体替代配置与原厂件采购方案按项目确认。

text.en: Send the model or part number to discuss your project.
text.zh: 提交型号或料号，沟通您的定制与采购需求。
